description: Figure 7(b) is a donut-style pie chart showing the distribution of task types for “Agency A” across turns in verified Wildchat journalist–LLM conversations, and it contains three slices. The largest slice is labeled “Article generation (82.9%)” and is colored red/pink, a smaller slice is labeled “Article editing (14.6%)” and is colored blue, and a very thin slice is labeled “Headline generation (2.4%)” and is colored a light orange/yellow. The chart has the text “Task Type” centered in the donut hole, and the slice labels with percentages are placed outside the ring; there is no separate legend and no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized.
